name: Inferno
source:
"Every morning of mine was just like the last: a stuffy apartment, a dusty metropolis outside the window, and complete loneliness. But today I woke up in a pioneer cabin with a beautiful landscape outside, and with a girl by my side to top it off! Everything seems great, except it's the wrong girl..."

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2897874040]Steam[/url]]
